title: US, China gear up for mid-September AI safety dialogue
description: The United States and China are set to engage in key talks about the safety implications of artificial intelligence. The discussions will focus on collaboration to monitor AI-driven cyberattacks and mitigate future risks. Additionally, they will consider the establishment of self-regulating AI laboratories and the sharing of relevant information.

title: AI may help identify breast cancers missed by mammograms, but clinical benefit remains uncertain
description: Artificial intelligence may help radiologists identify subtle signs of breast cancers that are missed during routine mammograms, and some AI systems may even identify patterns associated with an increased risk of cancer before it becomes visible on a mammogram, but there are still many significant limitations, according to a review led by investigators at the UCLA Health Jonsson Comprehensive Cancer Center.
